verdict.rationale: Auth0 publishes an official, first-party MCP server, documented on its docs site and in the auth0/auth0-mcp-server GitHub repo. It lets agents such as Claude Desktop, Cursor and Windsurf connect to a tenant via OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization and perform multi-step operations like creating apps, managing users, deploying Actions and debugging logs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration that the MCP server works as documented.
